      <h1>AI for a Sustainable Future</h1>
      <p class="sub">Sustainability Lab · IIT Gandhinagar</p>
      <p>We build AI that serves both people and the planet — from air quality and health sensing to energy and Earth observation.</p>
      <p>The lab is led by <a href="https://nipunbatra.github.io">Nipun Batra</a> and has 17 researchers today. Our 50+ alumni have gone on to Cambridge, Microsoft Research, Google DeepMind, CMU and industry.</p>
      <p class="awards-line">Recent recognition: <b>Best Paper Runner-Up at BuildSys 2026</b>, the <b>ACM e-Energy Test-of-Time Award 2025</b> for NILMTK, and the <b>ACM SIGEnergy Rising Star 2025</b>. Work published at NeurIPS, KDD, AAAI, IMWUT, BuildSys and UbiComp.</p>
